func (ImageDispatcher) RemoteMethodProfile(contract, method string) (string, bool)
func (ImageClient) Start(request ImageRequest) (result Admission, err error)
func (ImageClient) Observe(operation string, cursor, maxDeltas, maxBytes, waitMs int64) (result DeltaPage, err error)
func (ImageClient) Cancel(operation string) (result Cancellation, err error)
func (ImageDispatcher) DescribeService() (contract string, ready bool, why string)
func (ImageDispatcher) DescribeServiceMetadata() (guarantees []string, capabilities map[string]string)
func (ImageDispatcher) ServiceContract() string
func (ImageDispatcher) DescribeServiceDefinitionHash() string
func (ImageDispatcher) WriteFrame(frame []byte) error
func (ImageDispatcher) ExchangeFrame(frame []byte) ([]byte, error)
type ImageV2 interface
  StartWithGuarantees(request ImageRequestV2, guarantees []RequestGuarantee) (AdmissionV2, error)
  Start(request ImageRequestV2) (AdmissionV2, error)
  Observe(operation string, cursor, maxDeltas, maxBytes, waitMs int64) (DeltaPage, error)
  Cancel(operation string) (Cancellation, error)
type ImageV2Transport interface
  FrameExchanger
type ImageV2Client struct

func (ImageV2Client) Observe(operation string, cursor, maxDeltas, maxBytes, waitMs int64) (result DeltaPage, err error)

type Operator interface
  Hosts() (HostList, error)
  AddHost(expectedRevision string, host HostEntry) (HostChange, error)
  RemoveHost(expectedRevision, name string) (HostChange, error)
  Keys() (KeyList, error)
  IssueKey(program, credential string) (KeyIssued, error)
  RevokeKey(program string) (KeyRevoked, error)
  Audit(cursor, maxEntries int64) (AuditPage, error)
  Requests(cursor, maxEntries int64) (RequestPage, error)
  Gateway() (GatewayState, error)
  SetGateway(expectedRevision string, open bool, address string) (GatewayChange, error)
  ProgramBudgets(credential string) (ProgramBudgetPage, error)
  SetProgramBudget(request ProgramBudgetChange) (ProgramBudgetResult, error)
type OperatorTransport interface
  FrameExchanger
type OperatorClient struct
func NewOperatorClient(t OperatorTransport) *OperatorClient
type OperatorDispatcher struct
  Handler Operator
func (OperatorDispatcher) RemoteMethodProfile(contract, method string) (string, bool)
func (OperatorClient) Hosts() (result HostList, err error)
func (OperatorClient) AddHost(expectedRevision string, host HostEntry) (result HostChange, err error)
func (OperatorClient) RemoveHost(expectedRevision, name string) (result HostChange, err error)
func (OperatorClient) Keys() (result KeyList, err error)
func (OperatorClient) IssueKey(program, credential string) (result KeyIssued, err error)
func (OperatorClient) RevokeKey(program string) (result KeyRevoked, err error)
func (OperatorClient) Audit(cursor, maxEntries int64) (result AuditPage, err error)
func (OperatorClient) Requests(cursor, maxEntries int64) (result RequestPage, err error)
func (OperatorClient) Gateway() (result GatewayState, err error)
func (OperatorClient) SetGateway(expectedRevision string, open bool, address string) (result GatewayChange, err error)
func (OperatorClient) ProgramBudgets(credential string) (result ProgramBudgetPage, err error)
func (OperatorClient) SetProgramBudget(request ProgramBudgetChange) (result ProgramBudgetResult, err error)
func (OperatorDispatcher) DescribeService() (contract string, ready bool, why string)

func (OperatorDispatcher) ServiceContract() string
func (OperatorDispatcher) DescribeServiceDefinitionHash() string

type SelectionOperatorV2 interface

  Read(targetProgram, name string) (SelectionReadV2, error)
  Put(targetProgram, expectedRevision string, policy SelectionPolicyV2) (SelectionChange, error)
  DeletePolicy(targetProgram, expectedRevision, name string) (SelectionChange, error)
  ReadAccountDefault(name string) (SelectionReadV2, error)
  PutAccountDefault(expectedRevision string, policy SelectionPolicyV2) (SelectionChange, error)
  DeleteAccountDefault(expectedRevision, name string) (SelectionChange, error)
